    shade_m = (arr[:, :, 0] > 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 170) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 160)

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0042.png").convert("RGB"))

# Frame 41 pose: xc=0.567, yc=4.690, th=315 deg
# Frame 42 action: turn_deg=-90 -> th = 225 deg
# move_m=0.5: dx = 0.5*sin(225) = -0.354, dy = 0.5*cos(225) = -0.354
# xc = 0.567 - 0.354 = 0.213, yc = 4.690 - 0.354 = 4.336
xc, yc, th = 0.213, 4.336, np.radians(225.0)
f, H = 256.0, 1.55

# Let inspect cabinet vertices in obs_0042:
# Cabinet is white: R, G, B > 200
cab_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 180) & (img[:, :, 1] > 180) & (img[:, :, 2] > 180)
import scipy.ndimage as ndi
lbl, n = ndi.label(cab_mask)
print(f"Cabinet components: {n}")
# find largest
sizes = [np.sum(lbl == i) for i in range(1, n+1)]
main_idx = np.argmax(sizes) + 1
cab_pts = np.argwhere(lbl == main_idx)
print(f"Main cabinet component size: {len(cab_pts)}")
print(f"u range: [{cab_pts[:, 1].min()}, {cab_pts[:, 1].max()}]")
print(f"v range: [{cab_pts[:, 0].min()}, {cab_pts[:, 0].max()}]")

# Let find the 3 visible bottom corners of the cabinet:
# left bottom corner, middle bottom corner, right bottom corner
for u in range(cab_pts[:, 1].min(), cab_pts[:, 1].max()+1, 10):
    col = cab_pts[cab_pts[:, 1] == u]
    print(f"u={u}: max_v={col[:, 0].max()}")
'", "description": "Measure cabinet corners in obs_0042"}
